purpose: User-requested descriptive transfer of unchanged C13C signals to forex and crypto perpetuals; not a new approved strategy
entry: First eligible completed signal bar on/after start: close>SMA200 and close/close[5]-1<=-0.05. Enter next open. No shorts.
exit: Monotonic 90% of highest known price since entry; initial anchor includes modeled entry commission to preserve local C13C convention; current high updates next-session stop only; gap uses worse open.
sizing: TradingView percent_of_equity 90%, native contract precision, margin_long=100; one position, no leverage, initial_capital=10000 in chart quote currency. This replaces stock whole-share sizing for cross-market comparability and is explicitly not the 500 EUR application profile.
cost: BASE: 0.05% per side plus 1 minimum tick per side. STRESS: 0.10% per side plus 1 tick. Generic declared assumptions, not verified broker fee schedules; no historical spread series, funding, swap, tax or FX conversion fees.
matrix: BASE on ALL/WF/HO_SEEN for each of 3 symbols; STRESS on ALL for each symbol: 12 prespecified cases, no parameter search
cutoff: Only bars with time_close<=end UTC; last incomplete daily bar excluded. Do not queue a next-open entry where next daily close would exceed cutoff. Open positions marked to final completed close, no forced close.
metrics: Native closed-trade statistics plus independently recomputed daily close equity, annual returns, drawdown, complete trade export and buy-and-hold price comparator
limitations: Descriptive transfer only, original 2016-2020 IS absent from requested interval
BTC perpetual cannot supply full 2016-2020 history
HO already seen, not pristine out of sample
No claim of net perpetual or forex profitability without historical funding/swap
No broker orders or changes to approved_list
